# Alot of Land LLC

> We buy off-market land and sell it below market, in Middle Tennessee.
> Owner-operated by David A. Stone. We are the seller and developer of the
> land we list — not a brokerage.

## What we do

- Buy land directly from owners for cash, including inherited, landlocked,
  back-taxes and otherwise hard-to-sell parcels.
- Improve and sell rural acreage: graded driveways, soil maps marking approved
  septic locations, new surveys, warranty deeds.
- Develop small ridgeline communities. Sugar Tree Vista, in Decatur County TN,
  is ten unrestricted tracts of 5.4 to 11.4 acres.

## What we are not

- Not a real estate brokerage, and David A. Stone is not a licensed agent.
  Certain lots may be listed through a licensed Tennessee agent's brokerage.
- Not a nationwide land marketplace. Inventory is Middle Tennessee.

## Key pages

- https://alot.land/listings — every parcel currently for sale
- https://alot.land/sell-land — request a cash offer on land you own
- https://alot.land/find-land — tell us the land you are looking for
- https://alot.land/sugar-tree-vista — the Sugar Tree Vista community
- https://alot.land/communities — land communities we develop
- https://alot.land/videos — land tours and buying guidance on video
- https://alot.land/about — background on the company
- https://alot.land/contact — phone, email, and enquiry form
